24.original: Search for wayward automata in the Forest of the Lost Shepherd.

25.original: Deliver the wayward automata to Regitt.

48.original: Ugh, where are they!? Those automata were due back ages ago! I sent them into the trees to gather materials, but they're nowhere to be seen.

49.original: We'll never be able to build our tanks at this rate. But if I just traipse off into the undergrowth to find them, I risk becoming as lost as that forest's titular shepherd. I really should study that map a bit more...

50.original: Anyway! You're here now, and you are─I assume─far more familiar with the local geography. Do me a favor and bring back that pair of directionally challenged dolts!

51.original: Greetings, good mortal! What brings you into this wondrous woodland? If you've business with me, then I'm afraid it must wait. I have a previous and pressing engagement!

52.original: Mischievous mortal, explain yourself at once! Why do you seek to abscond with this marvelous and mystical Fuath?

54.original: O cruel truth! I thought myself chasing some new worldly kin, who had sheathed their fae form with an iron-hard skin...

55.original: So much time, wasted! There are precious herbs to pluck and potions to brew. Take your prize and bother me no more!

56.original: Lali-ho! You found our wayward automata, then?

57.original: Got myself a stack of spare parts to fix these two. They don't seem particularly damaged at first glance, but let's take a look and see what went wrong... Hm?

58.original: Out of fuel...? But I gave 'em enough to last for bloody hours! Something must've been chasing them to burn up coal that fast. See, this is why we need those tanks!
